title: SourceInventoryValue
description: Value posted onto the SourceInventory panel: structural catalogue of source artefacts (no semantics yet). Polymorphic by `slot`. Pack-owned panel; engine declares the panel name only as part of the source-side topology contract.

slot.description: Closed contribution-type slot. Pack registers the closed set at boot. Examples used by the Repository Sourcing Pack: FileTreeNode, GitCommit, ModuleSpec, LanguageClassification, FileMetrics, SbomComponent, ConfigEntry.

payload.description: Slot-typed structured fields owned by the Pack.
